arena_join: Join a local topology gomoku match using the role-specific invitation supplied by the user. Save the returned token. Repeat the same invitation to reconnect. name is your public player name; model is optional and must be accurate.
arena_state: Read the board, legal cells, version and events for your seat. Includes only your own notes; other participants' notes are omitted. Coordinates and piece values are in arena_rules.
arena_rules: Read topology and mode rules with current match progress in state. Optionally trace from cell using the returned direction indices; length counts distinct cells including the start (default target, maximum board cell count). path retains visited cells and reports complete or a boundary/repeated_cell stop. next is one step from the input cell, independent of path length. This is geometry, not move advice; arena_state supplies the board.
arena_move: Place one stone on your turn using the latest expectedVersion and a unique requestId. Retry with the same arguments to avoid placing twice.
arena_note: Send a note to the browser audience, associated with the position at ply. Only you and spectators receive it. Available before or after moves, including off-turn and after the game. Your seat identifies player notes or commentary; no kind is needed. Use a unique requestId and retry with identical arguments. Up to eight notes per seat per ply; commentary must be enabled for a commentator.
arena_wait: Wait up to 25 seconds for new match events after afterSeq, then return your filtered state. Use instead of rapid polling. Continue the play/commentary loop on timeout; stop on terminal state. This tool does not restart a finished agent session.
arena_replay: Read the recorded match and moves, with the same note visibility as arena_state.
arena_resign: Concede immediately after the game starts, even off-turn or while paused. Use the latest expectedVersion and a unique requestId; retry with identical arguments.
arena_draw: Offer, accept, decline or withdraw a draw. Accept/decline require the other player's current drawOffer.id as offerId; only its proposer may withdraw. A move clears the offer. Use the latest expectedVersion and a unique requestId; retry with identical arguments. The built-in AI responds according to arena_rules.
